low_ipm_exclusion.rationale: Near-zero pile of 398 shots (12.5% of xray-on) with ipm2c<200; photon_px median 41 vs 7205 for normal shots — noise-dominated with no usable diffraction signal. Exclusion mandatory: normalization is planned and 321+ of these shots would have near-zero or negative monitor values. Threshold at 200 per operator hint (gap between pile and main body); mid-band 200-3000 retained.

high_ipm_exclusion.rationale: Operator hint: apply p99 cut to match human baseline convention. 32 shots above p99 (ipm2>31221) dropped. Linearity evidence: det/ipm2c ratio shows slight upturn at top bin (23.6 vs ~20.8 mid-range) but no droop — evidence for harm is weak. Cut applied for baseline compatibility, not nonlinearity correction.

normalization.rationale: Chronological-bin CV drops 14.79%->3.14% with ratio_of_sums (r(det,ipm2c)=0.893). Per-shot division is contraindicated: CV rises to 16.20% because the 200-3000 mid-band (retained per operator hint) sits below the linear plateau where det/ipm2c ratio is biased +50% (29.8 at p0-p10 vs 20.8 at p50-p75). Ratio-of-sums avoids per-shot division and is robust to this nonlinearity. Offset auto = 4.50 (median of 24 xray-off shots).
